description: This file defines an event listener class 'EmailConfigurationListener' for the EmailConfiguration entity in the OrangeHRM application. It handles encryption and decryption of SMTP passwords during lifecycle events such as pre-persist, pre-update, post-update, and post-load.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationListener
classes.description: An event listener for EmailConfiguration entity managing SMTP password encryption/decryption.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts SMTP password before entity is persisted if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts SMTP password before entity update if encryption is enabled and the password has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts SMTP password after entity update if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts SMTP password after entity load if encryption is enabled.
